description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing DXVA picture buffers on Windows, including different buffer types and synchronization mechanisms for video decoding.

classes.name: DXVAPictureBuffer
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a DXVA picture buffer with methods for reuse, copying, and binding samples.

classes.name: PbufferPictureBuffer
classes.description: Derived class that manages a picture buffer using an RGBA EGL pbuffer, supporting initialization and surface copying.

classes.name: EGLStreamPictureBuffer
classes.description: Derived class that shares decoded textures with ANGLE via an EGL stream.

classes.name: EGLStreamCopyPictureBuffer
classes.description: Derived class that creates an NV12 texture, copies data, and shares it with ANGLE.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DXVAPictureBuffer instance.

methods.name: ReusePictureBuffer
methods.description: Reuses the picture buffer, implementation varies by derived class.

methods.name: CopyOutputSampleDataToPictureBuffer
methods.description: Copies sample data into the picture buffer.

methods.name: BindSampleToTexture
methods.description: Binds a sample to a texture for decoding.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the buffer, specific to derived classes.

methods.name: InitializeTexture
methods.description: Initializes the texture with specific parameters.
